title: Community of practice
descriptionByte:
Scope:

A Community of Practice for the funded Erasmus+ CoVE will provide occasions for projects to come together in person and online, foster mutual learning and networking. It will contribute to transferability and dissemination of outputs and results, knowledge sharing etc. It will build on the experience and achievements by existing projects and initiatives.

The objective of this Topic is to fund one consortium to run a Community of Practice for a four years duration for Erasmus+ CoVEs, to foster a collaborative and supportive environment with the aim to share good practices and experiences, keep the network engaged and identify solutions to the challenges encountered by the projects. More concretely, the Community of Practice is meant to support closer cooperation between the CoVE projects by facilitating learning, collaboration, and dissemination of results among the projects and to other stakeholders, to facilitate the building of synergies. It will also support sharing lessons learned to enhance the sustainability of projects’ results after the end of their funding from Erasmus+, to enhance their impact.

For more information, see the Erasmus + Programme Guide 2027.
